claims.limitation: PASS de timing não certifica correção.

evidence.quote: | C2-B mechanism/numerics | **MEDIDO_NO_TARGET** surrogate 20B; target diagnostic references | 20B 30 rows plain/streamed and delayed read bitwise; EIO/short/EOF abort fail closed. Both bounded 120B full-reference attempts failed RSS guard at 135/141 and 2/141 rows. Historical target only one final 201,088-logit vector after four token IDs bitwise vs isolated reference. Production GPU8/32 long-prefix parity **PARTIAL/BLOCKED**. |

claims.limitation: Surrogate e respostas funcionais não substituem o contrato target.

evidence.quote: | C2-C 32-slot sustained | **MEDIDO_NO_TARGET** 20 fixed requests, one process, 2156.499 s wall | 4588 / 1379.108 s decode = **3.326788 tok/s**; last half 3.289640; min request 2.848732. Timing/resource gate PASS; >=2 met, >=4 not met. Two tasks truncated at 512-token cap. |

claims.limitation: Não atingiu 4 tok/s nem qualifica numéricos.
claims.statement: Gate C2-C passou no âmbito timing/recursos.

evidence.quote: Performance/resource detail: C2-C was GPU8 (eight layers), 32 per-layer expert slots, context4096, batch256, microbatch32, eight CPU threads, four I/O threads, greedy/seed42/medium, no preload/repack, O_DIRECT expert reads, no prompt cache, one sequence/context. Enforced cgroup memory.max **18 GiB**, memory.swap.max=0; watchdog RSS17 GiB, GPU total<=7000 MiB, host MemAvailable>=6 GiB and CPU/GPU/NVMe limits 95/80/70 C. Peak C2-C `memory.peak` 15,344,664,576 B, GPU 3856 MiB, max CPU/GPU/NVMe 86/58/60.85 C; zero swap/max/OOM/kill events. On the 50-minute C2-E target run: peak cgroup 15,911,616,512 B, GPU 3858 MiB, max 90.375/58/60.85 C, zero swap/max/OOM/kill events; 8423 completion tokens in 2408.562 s decode = 3.497 tok/s on this different task mix. Device-exclusive physical NVMe bytes, per-tier host/device hits and H2D traffic are **DESCONHECIDO**. C2-C sampled process `read_bytes` rose 3.090 TB, C2-E target 4.442 TB; those counters are not physical device attribution. CPU/power-limit throttling behavior beyond sampled sensors is **DESCONHECIDO**.

claims.limitation: Não misturar cgroup, RSS e GPU nem inferir tráfego físico.
claims.statement: Picos e limites têm âmbito e unidades diferentes.

evidence.quote: All three responses ended naturally and had zero cached prompt tokens. The short prompt fails the prospectively declared <=10 s first-text and <=20 s first-final goals. The major measured component before first text is prefill: approximately 41/147/447 s, increasing with actual prompt length. First final content also includes the model's reasoning generation; it is not all prefill. The answer validator required exactly one JSON ticket value from the corresponding synthetic log. Its three PASS results show task-specific functional outputs, not general numerical parity.

These are client SSE *first nonempty text arrivals*, not per-token timing intervals. p50/p95 token interval: **NOT_MEASURED**. The client was run in one already loaded process in short→medium→long order; the short request was cold in expert slots, while the host had previous model runs and a count-only tokenizer probe. This is neither a cold-storage comparison nor a matched A/B across prompt lengths. Exact-prefix reuse: **NOT_RUN** because the profile disables prompt cache. Process read bytes and backend stage timers do not identify exclusive physical NVMe traffic or individual layer wait/compute.

claims.limitation: Ordem/caches impedem interpretação causal do comprimento.
claims.statement: Metas de first text e first final falharam.

evidence.quote: Utility decision: the new suite was fixed before model answers, with four development cases, twelve evaluation cases and correct/mutant validator checks. All twelve evaluation cases were run once per model; none was selected after seeing answers. The two target-only wins are real under the frozen 2048-token cap and validators. The ten shared successes, 11.478× time cost, short first-final latency of 74.506 s and narrow synthetic scope support a **selective fallback candidate** when the fast 20B produces no final answer at its cap, not default 120B use. A longer stock cap could alter those wins; it would be another prospectively frozen quality/cost experiment. No statistical significance or parameter-count causal claim follows from twelve cases. The earlier C1 8/10 tie remains unchanged.

claims.limitation: Dois exclusivos com stock sem final ao atingir o cap; sem superioridade geral.
claims.statement: Target 12/12 e stock 10/12 sob cap congelado.

evidence.quote: | C2-F operation | **MEDIDO_NO_TARGET** monitored localhost launcher | Full target SHA-256 preflight, context grew 86→663→2150 actual prompt tokens over three correct turns, cancel/follow-up PASS, clean shutdown and GPU/port release. Full 4K boundary/multi-client reliability NOT_RUN. |

claims.limitation: Não houve inspeção live do target para este relatório.
claims.statement: Modelo/backend/host são os da publicação histórica.

evidence.quote: Retained failures/limits: target smoke02 fails its 2.162 s telemetry boundary; 120B plain reference runs `c2-ref120b-cpu-all01/02` stopped at their declared secondary RSS guards without OOM and do not yield full-model parity; a first descriptive sustained report had an event-key bug, preserved under its original name with corrected `analysis-v2` authoritative. GPU8 plain full-reference weights alone exceed the RTX4060 VRAM budget, so no matching full-model GPU reference was run. Source audit and 20B fault injection do not replace an executed 120B in-flight eviction/stale publication or upload-error test. C2-E answers are functional tests, not proof of exact numeric computation across the token prefixes they traversed. Complete 4096-token prompt use, 8192 context, prefix reuse, physical-device-exclusive I/O and per-tier cache accounting remain NOT_RUN/DESCONHECIDO as documented.

claims.limitation: Inventário das publicações selecionadas, não de todos os raws.

evidence.quote: The C1 24-slot sustained 2.733 tok/s and three short 24/32 A/B pairs (2.568→3.269 mean) are retained as historical comparisons with different coverage. No fresh same-protocol sustained24 control was run, so the 3.327 C2-C figure is not a causal sustained 24→32 speedup. No candidate `-ngl12`, larger microbatch, predictor, prefetch, speculative decoder or three-tier cache was promoted: C2-B's independent numerical gate was not cleared. New optimization intervention count **0/6**. C2-D's prefill timings locate the observable delay but do not identify an exclusive per-layer I/O or compute bottleneck. Token interval p50/p95 is **NOT_MEASURED**; SSE first-chunk arrival is not a per-token interval. The task runner's nonstream API did not expose TTFT or reasoning/final token split; total completion tokens and reasoning/final character counts are retained.

claims.statement: Não existe sustained24 novo no protocolo C2.

evidence.quote: Next discriminating gate: qualify longer target token prefixes on a reference independent of the tested expert cache while preserving GPU8 placement or explicitly documenting a differential layer/kernel scope under the unchanged 18 GiB/zero-swap envelope. A new reference design must account for file-backed reclaim and avoid the RSS guard conflict that stopped both C2 attempts. Only after numerical coverage is sufficient should one profile the prefill wait/compute path and prospectively test a single placement or microbatch change against the 32-slot baseline. The selective fallback policy also needs a separate prospective latency/quality run if deployment is considered. These are reasons for a future experiment, not claims that this campaign completed them.

claims.statement: Próximo gate é referência independente admissível.
